findings.highlight: or are they just avoiding this place for some reason
findings.evidenceJa: それとも単に出払っているだけなのか
findings.governingReading: or are all the taxis simply out at the moment
findings.explanation: A mundane uncertainty about taxi availability becomes an ominous claim that taxis may be avoiding the location.

findings.highlight: is now just a group of lifeless buildings
findings.evidenceJa: 血の通わぬ作り物に還っていた
findings.governingReading: had reverted to a bloodless artificial construct
findings.explanation: The uncanny station-front park as a lifeless imitation is reduced to a group of buildings.

findings.highlight: she always walks home by herself
findings.evidenceJa: 一人さみしく帰るのもいつものこと
findings.governingReading: returning alone and lonely is also routine for her
findings.explanation: The woman’s habitual loneliness is omitted.

findings.highlight: she starts home like always
findings.evidenceJa: 揚々と家路についた
findings.governingReading: she sets off home in high spirits
findings.explanation: The contrast between her buoyant mood and the empty rotary disappears.

findings.highlight: her cold and silent silhouette
findings.evidenceJa: 無口で愛想のない影法師
findings.governingReading: a taciturn, unsociable shadow figure
findings.explanation: A personified description of her own shadow becomes an emotionally cold silhouette.

findings.highlight: Staying here is dangerous
findings.evidenceJa: ここにいては危ないなんて思ってしまった
findings.governingReading: she found herself thinking it was dangerous to remain there
findings.explanation: The woman’s involuntary impression is promoted into narrator-certified danger.

findings.highlight: she doesn’t have the sense to realize it even if she is in danger
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かにつけられても“危ない”なんて気付ける勘の良さなどない
findings.governingReading: she lacks the sharp intuition to detect danger merely from being followed
findings.explanation: A specific lack of intuition about being tailed becomes general inability to recognize danger.

findings.highlight: She is only human
findings.evidenceJa: 普通の、善良な一般市民
findings.governingReading: an entirely ordinary, decent member of the public
findings.explanation: The grounding description of her as an ordinary good citizen is replaced by a generic species statement.

findings.highlight: as if the whole world has abandoned her
findings.evidenceJa: 世界そのものから拒絶されているような不安
findings.governingReading: an unease like being rejected by the world itself
findings.explanation: Active existential rejection becomes passive abandonment.

findings.highlight: she’s running before she knows it
findings.evidenceJa: つんのめるように走っていた
findings.governingReading: she finds herself running as though pitching forward
findings.explanation: The unstable, near-stumbling bodily manner of her flight disappears.

findings.highlight: it’s not the work of a serial killer
findings.evidenceJa: 通り魔なんて項目はなかった
findings.governingReading: the recent unexplained incidents did not include a random street attacker
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces a category of indiscriminate street attack with a serial killer.

findings.highlight: an imitation in a mirror that will never find her
findings.evidenceJa: 誰も彼女を見つけてくれない、鏡の中の模造品
findings.governingReading: an imitation inside a mirror where nobody will find her
findings.explanation: The English makes the reflected town itself the agent unable to find her, obscuring her isolation from other people.

findings.highlight: Her usual route home seemed too dangerous
findings.evidenceJa: そっちに行くと取り返しがつかなくなる
findings.governingReading: taking that way felt as though it would make things irretrievable
findings.explanation: A premonition of an irreversible outcome is generalized to danger.

findings.highlight: Worms. Worms. Worms. Worms.
findings.evidenceJa: 草の陰から飛び出してくるモノ
findings.governingReading: things leap from the grass
findings.explanation: The mature branch names and repeats worms before the victim can identify what attacks her.

findings.highlight: drops on her right eye
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の頭上に落ちて
findings.governingReading: falls onto her from overhead
findings.explanation: A conditional mature variant specifies the right eye where the source gives only an overhead fall.

findings.highlight: It uses the snout larger than her eyeballs to crawl into her eye socket
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の頭上に落ちて
findings.governingReading: it falls onto her from above before the perception breaks
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents the creature’s oversized snout and explicit entry into an eye socket.

findings.highlight: She crumples to the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 体が背中から地面に倒れる
findings.governingReading: her body falls backward onto the ground
findings.explanation: A backward bodily fall becomes an unspecific collapse.

findings.highlight: Pain shoots through her heels
findings.evidenceJa: 足首に激痛が走った
findings.governingReading: agonizing pain shoots through her ankle
findings.explanation: The singular ankle injury becomes pain in plural heels.

findings.highlight: as if they’ve been chopped off with an axe
findings.evidenceJa: カカトから先が無くなったみたいに痛い
findings.governingReading: it hurts as though everything beyond the heel were gone
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents an axe and explicit chopping.

findings.highlight: many new things enter her body
findings.evidenceJa: 無くなったトコロから、ずふずぶと新しいモノが入ってくる
findings.governingReading: new things squelch into the place that feels absent
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds multiplicity and resolves the destination as the woman’s body.

findings.highlight: cut heel
findings.evidenceJa: 無くなったトコロ
findings.governingReading: the missing-feeling place
findings.explanation: A mature variant certifies a cut heel where the disoriented victim perceives an absent region.

findings.highlight: her remaining left eye
findings.evidenceJa: 血に塗れたまだ見える目
findings.governingReading: an eye still able to see despite being covered in blood
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the blood and asserts that the remaining eye is the left one.

findings.highlight: Indescribable horrors
findings.evidenceJa: ワケのわからないもの
findings.governingReading: things she cannot make sense of
findings.explanation: The victim’s perceptual incomprehension becomes narrator-level classification as horrors.

findings.highlight: Aha, it’s eating
findings.evidenceJa: あは
findings.governingReading: Aha
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds a lucid identification of feeding during a passage defined by her inability to perceive the action.

findings.highlight: The worms dive in
findings.evidenceJa: 蟲はじぶじぶと潜っていく
findings.governingReading: the insects wetly seep or burrow inward
findings.explanation: A slow, viscous penetration is changed to a clean diving motion.

findings.highlight: a sponge
findings.evidenceJa: お風呂場のスポンジ
findings.governingReading: a bath sponge
findings.explanation: The domestic childhood setting of the maggot memory is omitted.

findings.highlight: inchworms chewing through an apple
findings.evidenceJa: リンゴに穴をあけて踊る尺取虫
findings.governingReading: an inchworm boring a hole in an apple and dancing
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the uncanny dancing image with ordinary feeding.

findings.highlight: She has to hurry home
findings.evidenceJa: わたしはすぐに部屋に戻って
findings.governingReading: she will soon return to her room
findings.explanation: A routine future plan becomes urgent obligation.

findings.highlight: stay up till three o’clock
findings.evidenceJa: たまったビデオを消化して
findings.governingReading: work through the videos she has accumulated
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a three-o’clock bedtime.

findings.highlight: anything, please stop, please stop it hurts it hurts it hurts
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋に戻って戻って戻って
findings.governingReading: return to her room, return, return, return
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts bargaining pleas and repeated pain before the source shifts into direct pleading on the next page.

findings.highlight: her feet are gone, so she cannot walk
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋に戻りたい戻りたい戻りたいのに
findings.governingReading: she wants to return to her room but cannot complete the thought
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents explicit loss of both feet and a causal inability to walk.

findings.highlight: why, why, are you eating me
findings.evidenceJa: なにかってにわたしの
findings.governingReading: why—what are you doing to my…
findings.explanation: The mature branch completes the victim’s broken protest with an explicit question about being eaten.

findings.highlight: The meal tragedy ends in under five minutes
findings.evidenceJa: 惨劇は五分とかからずに終わった
findings.governingReading: the tragedy ends in under five minutes
findings.explanation: Exposed alternatives leave “meal tragedy” as a malformed hybrid at a decisive scene transition.

findings.highlight: too gruesome a scene to be called a meal
findings.evidenceJa: 仮に栄養を摂る事を食事と呼ぶのなら
findings.governingReading: if taking in nourishment is called eating, then for it this was precisely a meal
findings.explanation: The mature variant inserts the opposite evaluative premise before the source’s functional definition of feeding.

findings.highlight: an old man’s body
findings.evidenceJa: 干からびた老人の体
findings.governingReading: the body of a withered old man
findings.explanation: The desiccated condition of Zouken’s reconstructed body is omitted.

findings.highlight: I can never get used to this
findings.evidenceJa: 首の挿げ替えばかりは、いつになっても慣れぬものだ
findings.governingReading: I never grow accustomed specifically to replacing the head or neck
findings.explanation: Zouken’s concrete complaint about the reconstruction process becomes generic discomfort.

findings.highlight: A hoarse voice echoes through the park
findings.evidenceJa: しわがれた声が響く
findings.governingReading: a hoarse voice resounds
findings.explanation: mirror moon supplies the park as the voice’s location without support in the line.

findings.highlight: they replaced the woman’s body, the one they fed on
findings.evidenceJa: かつて女性だったモノの内部、自らが食い散らかしたモノの代わり
findings.governingReading: inside what had been a woman, the insects substitute for what they themselves devoured
findings.explanation: mirror moon makes the insects replace the whole woman’s body rather than the consumed interior and its functions.

findings.highlight: the heroic spirit who defeated Lancer, Assassin
findings.evidenceJa: 主不在の英霊
findings.governingReading: Assassin, the heroic spirit presently without a Master who defeated Lancer
findings.explanation: The narration’s explicit statement that Assassin is currently masterless disappears before his later pledge.

findings.highlight: All you require is a full body
findings.evidenceJa: 一人分の肉が必要なだけ
findings.governingReading: he merely needs one person’s worth of flesh
findings.explanation: A quantity of flesh is changed into the requirement for an intact whole body.

findings.highlight: The worms will function as your organs
findings.evidenceJa: 人間としての機能は蟲どもが果たす
findings.governingReading: the insects perform the functions required of a human body
findings.explanation: Bodily function is narrowed to anatomical organs.

findings.highlight: summoned by people who share my desire
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ望みを持つ召喚者にのみ呼び出される
findings.governingReading: summoned only by a summoner who shares the same desire
findings.explanation: The singular summoner condition becomes a broad class of people.

findings.highlight: the cry is not a laugh, but a cry of anger
findings.evidenceJa: 悦びによるものではなく、憤怒によるもの
findings.governingReading: the shaking voice that resembles laughter comes from rage rather than joy
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the emotional contrast between joy and rage with a contrast between laugh and cry.

findings.highlight: his soul remains alive
findings.evidenceJa: 魂器が潰されないかぎり
findings.governingReading: so long as his soul vessel is not crushed
findings.explanation: A concrete survival condition involving Zouken’s soul vessel is generalized to the soul remaining alive.

findings.highlight: as long as there are bodies to infest
findings.evidenceJa: 苗床となる肉体があり
findings.governingReading: while there is flesh or a body to serve as his cultivation bed
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns the body’s nursery-medium role into a generic supply of infestation targets.

findings.highlight: Turning his body into something inhuman
findings.evidenceJa: 自らを人でないモノに変貌させ
findings.governingReading: transforming himself into something nonhuman
findings.explanation: A statement about Zouken’s whole self and identity is narrowed to alteration of his body.

findings.highlight: There is a limit to this magic
findings.evidenceJa: その魔術には限界があった
findings.governingReading: that Magecraft has limits
findings.explanation: The setting’s technical Magecraft term is collapsed into generic magic.

findings.highlight: Programs become obsolete
findings.evidenceJa: 思考は、進化し続ける時代に追いつけなくなっていく
findings.governingReading: the program of thought can no longer keep pace with an age that continues to evolve
findings.explanation: The analogy’s relation between aging cognition and historical change is reduced to generic software obsolescence.

findings.highlight: the despair upon learning that your body is not human
findings.evidenceJa: 自らが人ではなく蟲なのだと受け入れる絶望
findings.governingReading: the despair of accepting that he himself is no longer human but an insect
findings.explanation: An existential identification of Zouken himself as worms is reduced to a nonhuman body.

findings.highlight: while retaining my humility
findings.evidenceJa: 人間として留まれる方式
findings.governingReading: a method by which he could remain human
findings.explanation: mirror moon mistranslates humanity as humility, corrupting the stated purpose of Zouken’s longevity method.

findings.highlight: Even after it is burned or cut
findings.evidenceJa: 肌が削げ、肉が落ちようと
findings.governingReading: even if skin is scraped away and flesh falls off
findings.explanation: Concrete losses of skin and flesh become generic burning or cutting.

findings.highlight: because there is an internal blueprint
findings.evidenceJa: 肉体そのものに遺伝子があるからだ
findings.governingReading: because the body itself contains genes as its blueprint
findings.explanation: The first explanation omits genes, weakening the setup for Zouken’s loss of the physical record.

findings.highlight: I lost my body, the place where my composition was recorded
findings.evidenceJa: 遺伝子そのものを失った
findings.governingReading: he lost the genes themselves that recorded his constitution
findings.explanation: Loss of the genetic record is rewritten as loss of the body serving as a storage location.

findings.highlight: the record of all the bodies within the concept of the astral world
findings.evidenceJa: 物体の記録、世界そのものの記憶体
findings.governingReading: a record of the physical object, a memory body of the world itself, belonging to the astral-world concept
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes the soul as a particular object’s world-memory record into a record of all bodies.

findings.highlight: last fifty years
findings.evidenceJa: 五十余年活動した
findings.governingReading: function for more than fifty years
findings.explanation: mirror moon drops that Zouken’s earlier replacement interval exceeded fifty years.

findings.highlight: the pain I feel as I rot away
findings.evidenceJa: その矮小さ、腐敗する苦しみ
findings.governingReading: the wretched smallness and pain of that decay
findings.explanation: Zouken’s self-disgust at the paltriness of his declining existence is omitted.

findings.highlight: I have persisted for that purpose
findings.evidenceJa: その為の死なない体よ
findings.governingReading: for that purpose he seeks a body that cannot die
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the concrete goal of an undying body with a vague claim that he has persisted.

findings.highlight: I hate all humans for being given bodies
findings.evidenceJa: 正しい肉体を授かる人間が恨めしい
findings.governingReading: he hates the humans who are granted proper bodies as though it were natural
findings.explanation: mirror moon broadens the target to all humans and omits the contrast with Zouken’s malformed body.

findings.highlight: the decay that melts his bones and flesh
findings.evidenceJa: 肌を溶かし肉を爛れさせ骨を侵す
findings.governingReading: decay that melts skin, festers flesh, and eats into bone
findings.explanation: Three distinct anatomical effects are collapsed, with bones incorrectly described as melting.

findings.highlight: must be unbearable for normal human beings
findings.evidenceJa: 常人ならば一時間と耐えられまい
findings.governingReading: an ordinary person could not endure it for even an hour
findings.explanation: The explicit one-hour endurance limit is omitted before the separate claim that an hour of decay kills the body.

findings.highlight: The body dies if it rots for over an hour
findings.evidenceJa: 一時間も腐れば肉体が死ぬ
findings.governingReading: after rotting for as much as an hour, the body dies
findings.explanation: mirror moon shifts the stated fatal threshold beyond one hour.

findings.highlight: Matou Zouken has gone insane
findings.evidenceJa: いかに正気であろうと、ソレは常道を逸脱したと評すべきだ
findings.governingReading: however sane he might be, he should be judged to have departed the normal human path
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces a distinction between sanity and human normality with categorical insanity.

findings.highlight: He prepared many things
findings.evidenceJa: いくつもの種を蒔き
findings.governingReading: he sowed many seeds in pursuit of the Grail
findings.explanation: A deliberate reproductive and long-term plotting metaphor becomes vague preparation.

findings.highlight: made possible by those sacrifices
findings.evidenceJa: 第三者の犠牲の上に成り立っている
findings.governingReading: his very existence rests upon the sacrifice of third parties
findings.explanation: The decisive correction from goal-related victims to unrelated third-party sacrifice loses its object.

findings.highlight: The skull waits
findings.evidenceJa: 髑髏がかしずく
findings.governingReading: the skull bows or kneels in attendance
findings.explanation: Assassin’s formal act of submission is mistranslated as waiting.

findings.highlight: bows to the rotting old magus
findings.evidenceJa: 礼を以って
findings.governingReading: bows his white skull to the rotting magus with formal respect
findings.explanation: The explicit respect that makes Assassin’s allegiance disturbing is omitted.
